openapi.message: s: the bearer token format changed from none to JWT
openapi.help: tell clients which token format to send

openapi.message: s: @openapi(oauth2_token_url) changed from "https://auth.example.com/token" to "https://auth.example.com/oauth/token"; clients configured with the old URL must move
openapi.help: keep the old URL answering until every client uses the new one

openapi.message: s.PlaceOrder.request_id: @openapi(header) added, so field 'request_id' moves into the Idempotency-Key header, which breaks clients that send or read it where it was
openapi.help: add a new field for the header instead of moving this one

openapi.message: s.Order.etag: @openapi(header) added, so field 'etag' moves into the ETag header, which breaks clients that send or read it where it was
openapi.help: add a new field for the header instead of moving this one

openapi.message: s.Orders.get: the operation can now answer 503; a client may not handle it
openapi.help: tell clients about the new response before the operation sends it

openapi.message: s.Orders.get: @openapi(auth) added, so operation 'get' no longer accepts bearer, which breaks clients without those credentials
openapi.help: keep the old requirement on these operations, or require the new one on new operations

openapi.message: s.Orders.get: @openapi(scopes) added, so operation 'get' no longer accepts bearer, which breaks clients without those credentials
openapi.help: keep the old requirement on these operations, or require the new one on new operations

openapi.message: s.Orders.place: the success code changed from 200 to 201 breaks clients that check for the old one
openapi.help: add a new operation instead of changing this one's success code

openapi.message: s.Orders.place: the 409 response changed from Problem to Conflict breaks clients that read the old one
openapi.help: add a new operation instead of changing this one's error responses

openapi.help: tell clients about the new response before the operation sends it
